english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for hurrying or trying to get something done quickly.

exampleSentences.english: We need to hurry and finish this homework.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋要趕住做完呢份功課。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gon2 zyu6 zou6 jyun4 ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hurrying yourself or doing a task hastily.

exampleSentences.english: I had to rush through my homework, so I had no time to think carefully.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我趕住做份功課，冇時間慢慢諗。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gon2 zyu6 zou6 fan6 gung1 fo3 mou5 si4 gaan3 maan6 maan6 nam2
